# Package prefixes that go-licenses cannot classify. Every entry requires Legal review.
# The tool's --ignore flag still checks each ignored package's dependencies.
#
# github.com/gagliardetto/treeout: no recognizable license file; MIT license reviewed manually.
github.com/gagliardetto/treeout
# github.com/holiman/bloomfilter/v2: MIT-LICENSE is not discovered by go-licenses.
github.com/holiman/bloomfilter/v2
# github.com/jackpal/go-nat-pmp: no recognizable license file; BSD-3-Clause reviewed manually.
github.com/jackpal/go-nat-pmp
# github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum: library source is LGPL; GPL applies only to cmd/ directories.
github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum
# Generated packages inherit the license of their parent Chainlink module.
github.com/smartcontractkit/chainlink-ccip/chains/evm/gobindings/generated
# Generated package layout prevents discovery of the parent Chainlink module license.
github.com/smartcontractkit/chainlink-solana/pkg/solana
